outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches the door through frames 10–35, then raises it toward the oven through frames 48–58. By frames 60–79, image and left_ego_image show the door upright and closed against the oven front; wrist_image also shows the raised door nearby. No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
